remainder {I J : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] (a : I → T.Tag) (b : J → T.Tag)
      (M η c ε : ℝ) : 0 ≤ M → 0 < η → 0 < c → 0 < ε → ∀ D : ℕ,
      ∀ᶠ r : ℝ in 𝓝[>] 0, ∀ x o y, Within r M η x o → Clear o y c → ∀ s,
      ‖T.grouped s a x b y -
        ∑ j : Fin (D+1), ∑ i : T.Channel j.val, T.coefficient a j.val i x o *
          T.grouped s (fun _ : Unit => ⟨j.val,T.actor j.val i⟩) (fun _ => o) b y‖
        ≤ r ^ ((D:ℝ) + 1 - T.weight a - ε)

proof_context.conclusion: Field `remainder`: for `M ≥ 0`, `η, c, ε > 0` and every `D`, eventually as r goes to 0 from the right, for clusters, `c`-clear spectators and every state `s : Option Character`, the remainder has norm at most `r^(D+1 - weight a - ε)`.

snippet.text:
remainder {I J : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] {d : I → ℕ} {e : J → ℕ}
      (a : Labels S d) (b : Labels S e) {M η c ε : ℝ}
      (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hη : 0 < η) (hc : 0 < c) (hε : 0 < ε) (D : ℕ) :
    ∀ᶠ r : ℝ in 𝓝[>] 0, ∀ (x : I → E4) (o : E4) (y : J → E4),
      WithinRoom r M η x o → ClearOf o y c → ∀ s : Viewers F,
      ‖whole (spectator F s) x a y b -
        ∑ j : Fin (D + 1), ∑ i : Q.channels j.val, Q.coef j.val i x a o *
          whole (spectator F s) (sole o)
            (sole (Q.actor j.val i) : Labels S (fun _ : Unit => j.val)) y b‖
        ≤ r ^ ((D : ℝ) + 1 - weight d - ε)

proof_context.conclusion: Internal form for all `Viewers F` (phases and mixture).
